# Test Suites & AI Automation Overview

SuperQA is not just another test management tool; it is a platform built from the ground up around the **SuperQA AI**, our proprietary testing intelligence engine. 

The **Test Suites & AI Engine** section is the core of your product experience. Here, you will design, organize, and automatically execute your test coverage without ever writing a single line of automation code.

## The Core Philosophy

Traditional testing requires brittle code, complex CSS selectors, and specialized automation engineers. SuperQA shatters this paradigm.

By leveraging the **SuperQA AI**, your entire team—from Product Managers to QA Analysts—can automate complex workflows using nothing but **plain English**. The AI natively understands your application's DOM, executes user interactions, handles file uploads, and validates assertions with complete autonomy.

## Navigating this Section

To master the SuperQA AI and organize your testing efforts, explore the following pages:

1. **[Suites](./suites.md)**: Learn how to create top-level domains to organize your QA architecture.
2. **[Scenarios](./scenarios.md)**: Discover how to group related testing goals within a specific domain.
3. **[Test Cases](./test-cases.md)**: Understand the critical difference between Regular and Reusable test cases, and how to import them flawlessly.
4. **[AI Execution & Steps](./ai-execution.md)**: Dive deep into the heart of the product—plain English automation, the **Omniblade Embedded Chrome Browser**, and the powerful **Layman Click & Record** feature.
